messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear TCMC Executive Search Team,

Your work across government, energy, utilities, industrial and infrastructure sectors in the UAE makes this a focused GCC introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG/social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, executive communications and complex stakeholder execution.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC, particularly where institutional engagement, responsible development and business strategy must work together.

My executive CV is attached for consideration for suitable current or upcoming assignments.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
